# Remix apps

Use when writing Remix / React Router framework-mode `loader`, `action`, route modules, or form mutations.

## Server vs client split
- Keep database queries, session cookies, and private env vars strictly inside `loader`, `action`, and `*.server.ts` files. Never import server-only modules from shared components.
- Return minimal serializable fields from `loader` instead of leaking full DB models into HTML hydration payloads.
- Revalidate auth and ownership inside every `action` and nested `loader`; sibling routes execute loaders in parallel rather than waiting on parent auth guards.

## Forms and mutations
- Prefer `<Form>` / `useFetcher` progressive enhancement over custom `fetch` + manual cache invalidation; let Remix revalidate route loaders automatically after actions complete.
- Always validate `await request.formData()` with a schema on the server and return structured field errors (`data({ errors }, { status: 400 })`).
- Set explicit `redirect()` targets only from server-validated routes; prevent open redirects on `?redirectTo=` parameters.

## Error handling and headers
Export route-level `ErrorBoundary` components and use `headers` carefully (`Cache-Control: private` on user-specific responses).

## Verify
Run `tsc --noEmit`, typegen + `vite build`, unit tests for loaders/actions (auth rejection + 400 errors), and smoke tests verifying navigation revalidation.
